Problem Statement:
Sanjay wants to become the largest of bears, or at least to become larger than his brother Midhun.Right now, Sanjay and Midhun weigh a and b respectively. It's guaranteed that Sanjay's weight is smaller than or equal to his brother's weight.Sanjay eats a lot and his weight is tripled after every year, while Midhun's weight is doubled after every year.After how many full years will Sanjay become strictly larger (strictly heavier) than Midhun?
input_spec: The only line of the input contains two integers a and b (1
output_spec: Print one integer, denoting the integer number of years after which Sanjay will become strictly larger than Midhun.
